title: Chapter 003
synopsis: Wira and Sylvia journey toward Gunung Bromo but face challenges with their mounts. They stop in Suradikarta to upgrade Sylvia's mount, discuss skills, and prepare to hunt a World Boss.

scenes.title: Journey to Suradikarta
scenes.summary: Wira and Sylvia discuss their mounts and decide to upgrade Sylvia's tired donkey. They make plans for future adventures and head to Suradikarta.
scenes.text: Wira and Sylvia pause their journey as they discuss upgrading mounts and gear.

events.summary: Wira comforts Sylvia about her mount and they decide to search for a nearby town.

scenes.title: Upgrade at Suradikarta
scenes.summary: Wira buys Sylvia a new mount and offers her additional equipment. They discuss skills and equipment for their upcoming battle.
scenes.text: In Suradikarta, Wira upgrades Sylvia's mount and offers her equipment while discussing skills.

events.summary: Wira buys Sylvia a new mount and additional gear for their upcoming challenges.

scenes.title: Preparing for the World Boss
scenes.summary: Wira and Sylvia discuss the upcoming challenge of fighting Buto Kalong and prepare for the confrontation.
scenes.text: They prepare to face Buto Kalong, discussing strategy and skills needed.

events.summary: Wira and Sylvia discuss their plans and the skills they need before facing Buto Kalong.
The World Boss Buto Kalong appears as they prepare for the fight.
